title: A retried task can read RETRY for ever: the copy stores its final state before the original stores RETRY, which replaces it
where: tracker es-ready-states (a late RETRY replaces a final FAILURE), in the reply on celery discussion 10681; this is a trigger without any fault
thread: celery discussion 10681 (the reply there), or a new issue if the lead prefers
observed: 768e476 with kombu 445027e, Redis broker and backend, two prefork workers -c 4, a task that always calls self.retry(countdown=0, max_retries=1): natural, nothing injected: 0 of 2000 read RETRY at the end. With mark_as_retry delayed 0.2 s (a RedisBackend subclass; injected): 4 of 20 read RETRY for ever after their last attempt stored FAILURE. The model's design retryFirst (store RETRY before publishing the copy) passes every property.
